🪶 Panthera X3 | In-Depth Product Review & Setup Guide 🪶

Scott takes a deep dive into the Panthera X3 ultralight wheelchair — breaking down the features that truly impact everyday performance, comfort, and independence.

This isn’t just a quick overview. Scott walks through the complete setup, explaining how each component works together and why small adjustments can make a big difference.

🔍 What’s covered in this review:

Centre of gravity — and how it affects balance, propulsion, and confidence

Sideguards — function, protection, and practical considerations

Upholstery and seating setup — comfort, posture, and long-term use

Folding mechanism — transport, storage, and real-world convenience

Overall ride performance as a complete chair configuration

Whether you're choosing your first active chair or refining your current setup, this video gives you practical insight into what makes the Panthera X3 stand out — and who it’s best suited for.

Choosing the right wheelchair is personal, and setup matters just as much as the frame itself.
